陈雨舒听了楚梦瑶的话，也尝了一口鱼香肉丝，果然偏甜。
她最近也在减肥，哪能吃甜食？于是直接将盘子推给了林逸。
林逸却是不管那么多，管它酸了还是甜了的，有肉吃就不错了！
折腾一天了，一直没吃东西，林逸接过了盘子，大口的吃了起来。
味道还真是不错，比村头王寡妇家开的小吃部强多了，不论是颜色搭配，还是用料，都考究许多，哪能是王寡妇那糖醋肉丝相比的？
这有钱人家的大小姐嘴也太刁了点儿吧？
楚梦瑶夹了一块水煮鱼放在了嘴里，品了品，小脸儿顿时被辣的通红，不停的哈着气，用小手在嘴边扇来扇区：
“好辣呀！不过好爽，水呢？水呢？”
一转头，看到桌上的橙汁，楚梦瑶拿起来直接对嘴咕嘟嘟的灌了起来，一口气喝了大半瓶，才放下了瓶子，道：“恩，这回舒服多了！”
陈雨舒看了看林逸，又看了看桌上的橙汁瓶，最后把目光落在了楚梦瑶的嘴上，脸上写满了不可思议。
而林逸，则是呆呆的看着楚梦瑶，心道，这城市里的女孩子就是开放啊，自己喝过的饮料瓶，她拿起来直接嘴对嘴，很猛很暴力！
楚梦瑶吃的喝的正爽呢，正要继续，却见得陈雨舒正用一种十分奇怪的表情看着自己，顿时有些莫名其妙：
“小舒，你看我做什么？”
“喔……没什么……”
陈雨舒叹了口气，可不敢告诉楚梦瑶事情的真相，不然以楚梦瑶的性格……哎，天知道能做出什么事儿来。
“没什么你看着我干什么呀？”
楚梦瑶更加莫名其妙，摇了摇头，自顾自的又夹起了一块水煮鱼，放入了口中，结果又被辣的不行，再次拿起了桌上的橙汁瓶，嘴对嘴的喝了起来……
“别……”
陈雨舒刚想阻止，却发现已经来不及了，只得把后面的话咽了回去。

“什么别？小舒，你到底在说什么呀？你怎么了？感觉怪怪的呢？”
楚梦瑶放下了橙汁瓶，用手抹了抹小嘴巴，皱着眉头看着陈雨舒。
“那个……我还是不说了……”
陈雨舒看着楚梦瑶那一无所知的表情，心里又同情又好笑。
最好笑的是，莫过于楚梦瑶喝了两次林逸喝过的饮料……这一次还不够么？
“小舒，你怎么也变得吞吞吐吐起来了？有什么事就说呀！”
楚梦瑶有些不高兴了，这干什么呀，神神秘秘的？
陈雨舒没办法，在楚梦瑶的逼问之下，只得指着桌上的喝的只剩下瓶底的橙汁饮料道：
“喔，这饮料……这饮料……”
“饮料怎么了？”
楚梦瑶皱了皱眉，道：“我不就是喝了你的饮料么？有什么的呀？保鲜柜里还有很多，你要喝，我再给你拿一瓶不就好了，至于这样么？”
见楚梦瑶还没有反应过来，陈雨舒终于忍不住大笑了起来：
“哈哈……不行了，笑死我了……瑶瑶姐，你还没发现么？那饮料不是我喝的……”
“不是你喝的？什么意思……”
话说到一半，楚梦瑶忽然意识到了点儿什么，将目光转向了林逸，脸色顿时剧变：“这饮料是你喝的？”
林逸无辜的点了点头，心道，看来是自己误会了，还以为是城里的女孩子开放呢，原来人家是搞错了……
“噗！”
楚梦瑶的脸立刻绿了，瞪大了眼睛，指着林逸想说什么，不过终究没有说出什么，就捂着嘴快步的向洗手间跑去。
“呕……”
洗手间里顿时传来干呕的声音，陈雨舒刚开始还有些幸灾乐祸，不过见到楚梦瑶的反应实在大了点儿，忙追着跑向了洗手间。

“瑶瑶姐……我都说了，还是不说了，是你非要我说的……”
陈雨舒苦着脸看着楚梦瑶，有些歉意的说道。
“那你怎么不早说……呕……”
楚梦瑶瞪了陈雨舒一眼，又开始对着洗手池干呕了起来……
“喔，不会吧……这么快就有反应了？”
陈雨舒看着楚梦瑶，有些疑惑的自言自语道：“妈妈说，亲嘴不会怀孕的呀！”
楚梦瑶刚刚好受了一点儿，听到了陈雨舒的话，顿时又是一阵恶心！
想起了自己与林逸那个家伙居然来了一次间接接吻，顿时眼泪就簌簌的落了下来！
自己珍藏了十八年的初吻，就这么没了？
楚梦瑶一阵头晕，几乎晕倒，委屈的瞪着陈雨舒：“怀你个大头鬼呀？你有没有生理常识？”

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author’s quick channel for copyright complaints. “Oh, I’ll give you the fish-flavored shredded pork!”
After listening to Chu Mengyao's words, Chen Yushu also took a bite of the fish-flavored shredded pork, which was indeed sweet.
She is also losing weight recently. How can she eat sweets? So he pushed the plate directly to Lin Yi.
Lin Yi doesn't care about it, whether it's sour or sweet, as long as it has meat, it's good!
After a day of hard work and nothing to eat, Lin Yi took the plate and started eating in big gulps.
The taste is really good, much better than the snack bar opened by Widow Wang in Cuntou. Both the color matching and the ingredients are very sophisticated. How can it compare with Widow Wang’s sweet and sour shredded pork?
Isn't the eldest lady from a rich family a bit too naughty?
Chu Mengyao took a piece of boiled fish and put it in her mouth. After tasting it, her face suddenly turned red from the spicy food. She kept breathing and fanned her mouth with her little hands:
"It's so spicy! But it's so refreshing. Where's the water? Where's the water?"
Turning her head and seeing the orange juice on the table, Chu Mengyao picked it up and drank it directly to her mouth. She drank more than half of the bottle in one go before putting the bottle down and saying, "Well, I feel much better this time!"
Chen Yushu looked at Lin Yi, then at the orange juice bottle on the table, and finally focused on Chu Mengyao's mouth, with disbelief written all over her face.
Lin Yi, on the other hand, looked at Chu Mengyao blankly and thought to himself, girls in this city are so open-minded. She picked up the drink bottle she drank from and put her mouth to mouth, very fierce and violent!
Chu Mengyao was enjoying her meal and drink, and when she was about to continue, she saw Chen Yushu looking at her with a very strange expression, and she suddenly felt a little confused:
"Xiao Shu, what do you think I am doing?"
"Oh...it's nothing..."
Chen Yushu sighed, but he didn't dare to tell Chu Mengyao the truth of the matter, otherwise with Chu Mengyao's character...hey, God knows what he could do.
"Nothing, what are you looking at me for?"
Chu Mengyao was even more confused. She shook her head and picked up another piece of boiled fish and put it in her mouth. However, it was so spicy that she picked up the orange juice bottle on the table again and drank it mouth to mouth...
"Don't..."
Chen Yushu just wanted to stop it, but found that it was too late and had to swallow the next words.
"What's the difference? Xiao Shu, what are you talking about? What's wrong with you? Do you feel weird?"
Chu Mengyao put down the orange juice bottle, wiped her mouth with her hand, and looked at Chen Yushu with a frown.
"That...I still won't say anything..."
Chen Yushu looked at Chu Mengyao's clueless expression, feeling sympathetic and amused.
The funniest thing is that Chu Mengyao drank the same drink that Lin Yi drank twice... Wasn't this time enough?
"Xiao Shu, why are you so hesitant? Just tell me if you have anything to say!"
Chu Mengyao was a little unhappy, what are you doing, mysterious?
Chen Yushu had no choice but to point to the orange juice drink at the bottom of the bottle on the table and said under Chu Mengyao's questioning:
"Oh, this drink... this drink..."
"What happened to the drink?"
Chu Mengyao frowned and said, "Didn't I just drink your drink? Is there anything else? There are still many in the crisper. If you want to drink, I can just get you another bottle. Is that all?"
Seeing that Chu Mengyao had not yet reacted, Chen Yushu finally couldn't help laughing:
"Haha... No, I'm laughing so hard... Sister Yaoyao, haven't you noticed yet? I didn't drink that drink..."
"You didn't drink it? What do you mean..."
Halfway through the words, Chu Mengyao suddenly realized something, turned her gaze to Lin Yi, and her expression suddenly changed: "Did you drink this drink?"
Lin Yi nodded innocently and thought to himself that it seemed that he had misunderstood and thought that girls in the city were open to the public. It turned out that they were mistaken...
"Poof!"Chu Mengyao's face immediately turned green, her eyes widened, she pointed at Lin Yi and wanted to say something, but in the end she didn't say anything, so she covered her mouth and ran quickly to the bathroom.
"Ugh..."
The sound of retching suddenly came from the bathroom. Chen Yushu was a little gloating at first, but when he saw Chu Mengyao's reaction, he was a little louder and hurriedly chased her to the bathroom.
"Sister Yaoyao...I have already said it, but I still won't say it. It was you who insisted on me..."
Chen Yushu looked at Chu Mengyao with a bitter face and said apologetically.
"Then why didn't you tell me earlier... ugh..."
Chu Mengyao glared at Chen Yushu and started retching into the sink again...
"Oh, no way... you reacted so quickly?"
Chen Yushu looked at Chu Mengyao and said to herself with some confusion: "Mom said you won't get pregnant by kissing!"
Chu Mengyao had just felt better, but when she heard Chen Yushu's words, she suddenly felt sick again!
I remembered that I had an indirect kiss with that guy Lin Yi, and tears suddenly fell down!
The first kiss that he had treasured for eighteen years was just gone?
Chu Mengyao felt dizzy and almost fainted. She stared at Chen Yushu aggrievedly: "Are you pregnant with a big head? Do you have any common sense about physiology?"
